pages.text: Cast with blessed silver to purge the undead plague.$(br2)Deals $(6)4.0x damage$() to undead fiends, and $(b)2.0x damage$() to vampire players with an ethereal chime.
$(bold)Offhand Chambering$()$(br2)To prioritize Silver over lead ball, place rounds in your $(italic)offhand (slot 40)$() before reloading [R].$(br2)The weapon primes the blessed round first.
$(bold)Tier 1: Altar Table$()$(br2)Shaped crafting table:$(br)• Top: Iron Nugget (Silver)$(br)• Mid: Paper + Powder + Paper$(br)• Bot: Wad$(br2)Yields 2 Consecrated Silver Cartridges.

$(bold)Tier 2: Mechanical Crafter$()$(br2)Powered 3x3 crafter array:$(br)• Corners: Large Bullet Core (4)$(br)• Edges: Wad (4)$(br)• Centre: Gunpowder Charge (1)$(br2)Yields 4 Consecrated Silver Cartridges.
$(bold)Tier 3: Holy Assembly$()$(br2)Sequenced line:$(br)1. 16.5mm Ammo$(br)2. Deploy Silver$(br)3. Fill Holy Water$(br)4. Mechanical Press$(br2)Yields $(6)8 Blessed Rounds$()!
$(bold)Tactical Doctrine$()$(br2)Carry a pouch of silver cartridges when entering catacombs, crypts, or night patrol.$(br2)A single well-aimed shot will banish most high-tier undead instantly.
